name: Frozen Fingers Ghaziabad 2018
information:
Online Registration ends on 21st December and On the spot registration is available on 29th December from 8:30 to 9:00 AM. 
The main event for the competition is 3x3 One-Handed. 3x3 One-Handed Winner will be declared the winner of Frozen Fingers Ghaziabad 2018.
